title: Duality of gate execution
statement: Let $G$ be a list of gates and $I$ a list of Boolean values. Assume that for each position $i$ in $G$, every argument index of the gate at position $i$ is less than the length of $I$ plus $i$, and that every NOT gate in $G$ has exactly one argument. Then executing the gates obtained by interchanging AND and OR while retaining NOT and the argument lists, starting from the entrywise negation of $I$, produces the entrywise negation of the result of executing $G$ starting from $I$.
